evals.prompt: I'm starting a new PowerShell module project called 'PSUtilities'. It'll have Public and Private function folders and a tests/ directory with Pester 5 tests. Can you scaffold the full build system using PowerShellBuild — I need build.ps1, psakeFile.ps1, and requirements.psd1. I want code coverage at 80% and PSScriptAnalyzer enabled.
evals.expected_output: Three files: build.ps1 (Bootstrap + Invoke-psake entry point), psakeFile.ps1 (Import-Module PowerShellBuild, properties block with PSBPreference settings for coverage threshold 0.80 and ScriptAnalysis, tasks using -FromModule PowerShellBuild), requirements.psd1 (psake, PowerShellBuild, Pester, PSScriptAnalyzer, platyPS). Structure follows PowerShellBuild conventions.

evals.prompt: My PowerShellBuild project builds fine locally but I need to set up GitHub Actions CI. I want it to run tests on every push and PR, then publish to PSGallery automatically when I push to main. The API key should come from a GitHub secret called PSGALLERY_API_KEY.
evals.expected_output: A GitHub Actions workflow YAML with two jobs: test (runs on push/PR, calls ./build.ps1 -Task Test -Bootstrap on windows-latest) and publish (depends on test, only on main branch, passes PSGALLERY_API_KEY secret as env var). Uses actions/checkout@v4.

evals.prompt: I want to use Invoke-Build instead of psake for my PowerShellBuild project. Can you show me how to set up the .build.ps1 file? I need to compile the module into a single PSM1 from Classes, Private, and Public folders, run code coverage, and exclude any .Tests.ps1 files from the build output.
evals.expected_output: A .build.ps1 using Invoke-Build syntax: Import-Module PowerShellBuild -Force, . PowerShellBuild.IB.Tasks, then PSBPreference settings for CompileModule=$true, CompileDirectories=@('Classes','Private','Public'), Exclude=@('*.Tests.ps1'), CodeCoverage.Enabled=$true. Default task set to Build or Test.
